items.title: Density of polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms
items.summary: A machine-checked proof, in Lean 4 with Mathlib, of the polynomial Lindenstrauss theorem: for every real or complex Banach space X and every n ≥ 1, the n-homogeneous polynomials whose Aron–Berner extensions attain their norms are dense, for scalar and for vector values.
